annotations.title: Save or remove a table row

description: Writes or deletes one table row as the developer; no undo. "save": { owner, data } or { group, data } adds a row, { id, data } replaces that row's whole data; "remove" { id }. Users still see only their own rows. In a free table (kind "free", in the developer's own database) owner may be "g:<group>" or none, a compound key's id is an object of its columns, and a key-less one only adds. Reads: neblla_table_query. More: neblla_get_llms tools/table_row

action.description: "save" or "remove". By action: save {owner, data}; remove {id}

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

data.description: save: the row's fields, as declared.

env.description: "pro" (the published app, what users have) or "pre" (the private test copy); left out: the environment the developer picked for this app in the panel.

group.description: save: or the group (neblla_group) that owns the new row.

id.description: The row to replace or delete; in a free table with a compound key, { column: value }.

owner.description: save: the user id of a new row.

table.description: A table declared in the app.

name: neblla_table_row
title: Save or remove a table row
